hse011_source_registry.purpose: Machine-readable catalog of all authoritative external sources for HSE-011 deep knowledge ingestion

classification.C: Official source repository (GitHub) from source owner

sources.name: OpenGL 3.3 Core Profile Specification
sources.relevance_to_hse: Definitive specification for OpenGL API behavior, state machine, buffer operations, shader compilation. HSE uses OpenGL 3.3 core profile directly.
sources.authority_notes: Primary standard from the OpenGL governing body. All other OpenGL references derive from this.

sources.name: OpenGL Reference Pages
sources.relevance_to_hse: Quick reference for individual OpenGL functions. Complements the full specification with practical examples.
sources.authority_notes: Maintained by community but based directly on Khronos specs. More practical than the spec PDF.

sources.name: GLFW 3.4 Documentation
sources.relevance_to_hse: HSE uses GLFW directly for window creation, OpenGL context, and input. Essential for understanding HSE's window/input layer.
sources.authority_notes: Official documentation from GLFW maintainers. Authoritative for GLFW API.

sources.name: GLFW 3.4 Source Code
sources.relevance_to_hse: Reference implementation for window/input handling. Shows how platform-specific details (Win32, X11, Wayland) are abstracted.
sources.authority_notes: Official source from GLFW maintainers. Shows actual implementation behind the documentation.

sources.name: GLEW Documentation
sources.relevance_to_hse: HSE uses GLEW for OpenGL extension loading. Understanding how extension loading works is critical for HSE's renderer.
sources.authority_notes: Official GLEW documentation. Simple library with straightforward API.

sources.name: LearnOpenGL
sources.relevance_to_hse: Comprehensive tutorial covering OpenGL 3.3 core profile. Well-written with working examples. Covers topics HSE doesn't yet implement (PBR, shadows, SSAO).
sources.authority_notes: Not official Khronos documentation, but widely regarded as the best OpenGL tutorial. Source code available on GitHub with 12K+ stars.

sources.name: LearnOpenGL Source Code
sources.relevance_to_hse: Working OpenGL 3.3 code examples. Reference for how OpenGL functions are used in practice.
sources.authority_notes: Source code for LearnOpenGL tutorials. 12K+ stars on GitHub.

sources.name: bgfx Source Code
sources.relevance_to_hse: Reference for how to abstract across rendering backends (OpenGL, Vulkan, Metal, D3D). Shows resource lifecycle management patterns.
sources.authority_notes: Battle-tested in many game engines and tools. 14K+ stars, maintained since 2013.

sources.name: Godot Engine Source Code
sources.relevance_to_hse: Reference for scene graph architecture, resource lifecycle, renderer design. Shows how a complete game engine structures its systems.
sources.authority_notes: One of the most popular open-source game engines. 90K+ stars. Used in production games.

sources.name: OGRE 3D Source Code
sources.relevance_to_hse: Mature scene graph and rendering engine. Referenced by Game Engine Architecture textbook. Shows proven patterns for resource management and scene organization.
sources.authority_notes: One of the longest-standing open-source 3D engines. Referenced by Jason Gregory's Game Engine Architecture book.

sources.name: Hazel Engine Source Code
sources.relevance_to_hse: Educational game engine with clear architecture. Shows layer stack pattern, event dispatching, renderer initialization. Good architectural reference for HSE.
sources.authority_notes: Educational engine with 13K+ stars. Code is well-structured and extensively documented through YouTube videos.

sources.name: Dear ImGui Source Code
sources.relevance_to_hse: Reference for immediate-mode UI pattern. Shows how to output vertex buffers for rendering without touching GPU directly. Could inform HSE's UI approach.
sources.authority_notes: The definitive immediate-mode GUI library. 50K+ stars, used in countless projects. Authoritative for IMGUI paradigm.

sources.name: Filament Source Code
sources.relevance_to_hse: State-of-the-art PBR rendering engine. Reference for material systems, lighting models, and advanced rendering techniques HSE may implement.
sources.authority_notes: Google-backed, 20K+ stars. Comprehensive PBR documentation with mathematical derivations.

sources.name: Filament PBR Theory Document
sources.relevance_to_hse: In-depth PBR theory with mathematical derivations. Explains BRDF models, lighting equations, and material parameterization. Essential for any PBR implementation.
sources.authority_notes: Authoritative PBR reference from Google's rendering team. Can be used as implementation guide for any engine.

sources.name: GLM (OpenGL Mathematics)
sources.relevance_to_hse: Header-only math library implementing GLSL math in C++. Reference for how to implement vec3, mat4, quaternions, and transformation functions.
sources.authority_notes: The standard math library for OpenGL C++ projects. 11K+ stars. Based directly on GLSL spec.

sources.name: GLM Manual
sources.relevance_to_hse: Comprehensive reference for GLM types and functions. Shows how vec3, mat4, quaternions work in practice.
sources.authority_notes: Official GLM documentation. Directly maps to GLSL math.

sources.name: Magnum Engine Source Code
sources.relevance_to_hse: Lightweight C++11 graphics middleware. Shows clean OpenGL abstraction patterns, resource management, and scene graph design.
sources.authority_notes: Well-designed C++ graphics library. Good reference for clean abstraction patterns.

sources.name: SDL3 Source Code
sources.relevance_to_hse: Cross-platform multimedia library. Reference for platform abstraction, input handling, and rendering backend patterns.
sources.authority_notes: One of the most widely used cross-platform libraries. 12K+ stars. Used by thousands of games and applications.

sources.name: Dear ImGui Wiki - IMGUI Paradigm
sources.relevance_to_hse: Definitive explanation of immediate-mode GUI paradigm. Clarifies common misconceptions about IMGUI vs retained mode.
sources.authority_notes: Written by Dear ImGui's creator. Authoritative for understanding IMGUI paradigm.

sources.name: cppreference.com - C++ Standard Library
sources.relevance_to_hse: Definitive reference for C++ standard library. Covers smart_pointers, containers, threading, and other features HSE uses.
sources.authority_notes: Community-maintained but based on ISO C++ standard. Widely regarded as the most accurate C++ reference.

sources.name: Microsoft C++ Documentation
sources.relevance_to_hse: HSE uses GCC/MinGW but runs on Windows. Microsoft docs cover Windows API, MSVC-specific behaviors, and debugging tools.
sources.authority_notes: Official Microsoft documentation. Authoritative for MSVC and Windows-specific C++ behavior.

sources.name: miniaudio Source Code
sources.relevance_to_hse: Single-file audio library. Reference for audio playback implementation patterns if HSE adds audio.
sources.authority_notes: Single-file audio library. Widely used. Well-documented.

sources.name: Tracy Profiler Source Code
sources.relevance_to_hse: Real-time profiler. Reference for instrumentation patterns and frame-level performance analysis.
sources.authority_notes: The gold standard for real-time frame profiling in games.

sources.name: CMake Documentation
sources.relevance_to_hse: HSE uses CMake. Understanding CMakeLists.txt patterns is essential for build configuration.
sources.authority_notes: Official CMake documentation. Authoritative for CMake usage.

sources.name: Game Engine Architecture (Book)
sources.relevance_to_hse: Definitive textbook on game engine architecture. Covers all major subsystems. References OGRE as example implementation.
sources.authority_notes: Written by lead programmer at Naughty Dog (Uncharted, The Last of Us). Industry standard reference.

sources.name: Flecs ECS
sources.relevance_to_hse: Fast, lightweight ECS. Reference for entity-component patterns if HSE moves toward ECS architecture.
sources.authority_notes: Most popular C/C++ ECS library. 7K+ stars. Battle-tested.

sources.name: EnTT ECS
sources.relevance_to_hse: Header-only C++ ECS. Used by Godot 4. Reference for modern C++ ECS patterns.
sources.authority_notes: Used by Godot 4. 10K+ stars. Modern C++ design.

sources.name: Box2D Source Code
sources.relevance_to_hse: Reference for 2D physics implementation. Shows collision detection, constraint solving, and simulation loop patterns.
sources.authority_notes: The standard 2D physics library. Used by Unity, Godot, and countless games. 9K+ stars.

sources.name: Bullet Physics Source Code
sources.relevance_to_hse: Reference for 3D physics implementation. Shows broadphase, narrowphase, constraint solver patterns.
sources.authority_notes: Most widely used open-source 3D physics engine. Used by many commercial games.

sources.name: Real-Time Rendering (Book)
sources.relevance_to_hse: Definitive textbook on real-time rendering algorithms. Covers topics beyond basic OpenGL (PBR, shadows, GI).
sources.authority_notes: Industry standard rendering reference. Covers both theory and practical algorithms.

sources.name: nlohmann/json
sources.relevance_to_hse: Header-only JSON library. Reference for serialization patterns if HSE adds JSON support.
sources.authority_notes: The standard C++ JSON library. 42K+ stars. ISO C++ compliant.

sources.name: Cereal Serialization
sources.relevance_to_hse: Header-only C++ serialization library. Reference for serialization patterns if HSE adds save/load functionality.
sources.authority_notes: Well-established serialization library. 3K+ stars.
